description: Get just the syllabus HTML body for a course, returning { course_id, syllabus_body } where syllabus_body is null if the course has none set. Use get_course with include: ['syllabus_body'] instead when you also need other course fields in the same call, or update_course to change the syllabus body. If the course has public_syllabus or public_syllabus_to_auth enabled, the body may be readable even by callers without an enrollment in the course.
name: get_syllabus
title: Get Syllabus
